html:
Operation Bagration was the Soviet offensive in Belarus in summer 1944 that destroyed the German Army Group Centre, the largest German defeat of World War II.

It began on 22 June 1944, three years to the day after Germany invaded the Soviet Union, and two weeks after the Allied landings in Normandy. Partisans cut German railways the night before. Soviet armies broke through at Vitebsk and Babruysk and trapped huge German forces east of Minsk, which fell on 3 July. Within weeks the Red Army reached the Vistula and the borders of East Prussia. Germany lost several hundred thousand men. The offensive freed Belarus and set the stage for the Warsaw Uprising.
sum: Operation Bagration was the Soviet offensive in Belarus in summer 1944 that destroyed the German Army Group Centre, the largest German defeat of World War II.
